@graph.description: Premium backyard saunas in Aurora, delivered and installed for $1,750. Serving Aurora Estates, Hills of St Andrew, Aurora Highlands and more. Visit our King Township showroom.

mainEntity.name: How far is your showroom from Aurora?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our showroom is at 17380 Highway 27 in Schomberg, King Township, a short drive west of Aurora. Visits are by appointment.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Aurora?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. Properties near regulated watercourses may also need conservation authority sign-off. We check before you order.
All of our cedar saunas are used year-round. For the most efficient winter heat, the Studio Six Mini and Max are fully insulated and aluminum-clad.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Aurora?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Aurora. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
